g.text: Nine rewriters on the v2 and v3 summary prompts, held-out passages

font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526379

g.text: Bars show individual runs; no confidence intervals or averaging of repetitions.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526379
font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526379

g.text: GPU allocation: PyTorch peak allocated bytes on CUDA device 0, including resident weights and inference intermediates; excludes unused cached memory, other allocations, and CPU RAM.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526379

g.text: Inference time: prompt processing + generation; excludes model loading and input preparation.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526379

g.text: Nothing here scores quality; read side-by-side.md. Valid means finished before the token limit, nonempty, and free of reasoning tags.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526379

g.text: Numbers and qualifiers kept pool every passage's distinct numbers (section labels such as 8.2 excluded) and words such as may, unless, only, not, and knowingly; a drop flags a rewrite to check, and keeping them proves nothing. Qualifiers added: an exception, only, or a negation the passage lacks, which can reverse a promise; rewording such as irreversible to cannot be undone also counts.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526379

g.text: Reading grade: Flesch-Kincaid, pooled over valid rewrites; the passages themselves score 16.5. Copying: the copied-run length an average rewrite word sits in (Grusky et al., 2018); 1-2 means the model's own words. Format breaks: an opening such as "Here's the summary:", or any Markdown.
